_about: Plate spec for the CRED IndusInd Bank RuPay card film, AI-plate route. One consistent style across every plate; no text, no logos, no card numbers in any plate (type, foil band, card, docket and lockup are rendered in code). UNOFFICIAL SPEC WORK.
style: fine banknote engraving illustration on soft cream paper, dense cross-hatching and stipple, a single watercolour tint wash, large paper negative space, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, soft vignette, 16:9
